prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production web hero image for the Korean fortune service "꿀꿀 운세" (Ggulggul Unse) and its sister cat consultation service. Wide landscape 1536x1024.

Reference images (attached, in order):
- image 1 = YEONI the flower pig. MANDATORY identity reference: pink chibi pig, one huge pink LOTUS flower on the top-left of her head (viewer's left), glossy dark-brown eyes, round pink snout, soft purple/lavender neck scarf tied in a bow, short rounded body, little curled tail. Keep exactly these proportions, colours and shapes.
- image 2 = YEONGNYANGI the white cat. MANDATORY identity reference: fluffy long-haired white cat with pink inner ears, half-lidded calm violet-indigo eyes, navy/black pointed wizard hood-hat decorated with a gold crescent moon and small gold stars and a gold tassel, black robe with gold trim and purple lining, dark collar with a round blue gem pendant, pink paw pads, big fluffy white tail. Keep exactly this face, fur, hat, robe and eye colour. Any hanging tag on the robe must be completely blank (no letters).
- image 3 = style of the warm DAY room (cream walls, wooden lattice frames, sheer pink curtains, round moon-gate window to a lotus pond, low tea table).
- image 4 = style of the NIGHT consultation study (deep navy walls, dark wooden desk, brass armillary sphere, arched window with full moon over misty mountains).
- image 5 = the approved painting style of both characters together (high-end cute storybook illustration, softly shaded 3D-like characters, painterly details, delicate light).

Scene "two doors at dusk": one continuous room that is half day garden and half moonlit study.
- LEFT half: Yeoni's warm daytime garden room in the style of image 3 — soft peach-cream sunlight, sheer pink curtain, round moon-gate window with pink lotus pond and blossoms, a few pink lotus flowers in the foreground.
- RIGHT half: Yeongnyangi's night consultation study in the style of image 4 — deep navy and indigo, arched window with a full moon and stars, warm amber paper lantern glow, a few star sparkles.
- The two halves blend softly through the middle like twilight (gentle peach-to-indigo gradient, no hard seam, no wall dividing them).
- CENTER: one low round wooden tea table with a small celadon teapot, two cups and an open cream book. Yeoni sits on the LEFT side of the table, Yeongnyangi sits on the RIGHT side; they face each other three-quarter toward the viewer, both gently smiling, sharing tea, friendly and calm.
- Both characters and the table must stay inside the central 50% of the width and the middle of the height, full bodies visible, nothing cropped, comfortable margin above the hat and lotus — so that a centred square crop still shows both characters completely.
- Character size: each character about 35-40% of the image height.

Strictly: no words, no letters, no Korean or Latin characters, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no borders, no frames, no watermark, no signature. No extra characters or people. Calm, premium, warm; not a purple tarot cliche.

candidates.decision: not used — identity matched, but the day/night boundary reads as a wall and curtain rather than a dusk transition

yeoni.prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE new illustration (do not edit the attached images).

Purpose: the face art of a luxurious tarot-style "mode select" card titled "종합 운세 백화점" (a grand fortune department store) on a Korean fortune-telling website. The card frame and all text are added later in HTML, so the image itself must contain NO text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, signage, watermark, frame or border.

Scene: Inside an elegant, luxurious fortune emporium hall with warm golden lamplight, ivory marble and polished rosewood, arched display niches and glass vitrines. The pink piglet character 연이 (image 1 = identity reference) stands at the center, welcoming the viewer with one front hoof raised in a friendly gesture. On the shelves and vitrines on both sides, beautifully arranged fortune goods suggest many choices from simple to premium: neat tarot decks, rolled saju scrolls tied with ribbon, a celestial star-chart globe, a crystal ball on a gold stand, small ceramic honey jars, an elegant tea set, lotus flowers. Abundant but orderly, premium boutique feeling. Palette: ivory, blush rose, champagne gold, soft warm light. Absolutely no purple gradient background.

Character identity (must match image 1 exactly): chubby pink piglet, big glossy brown eyes, a large pink lotus flower on the upper-left of the head, lilac/purple scarf tied at the neck, soft pink body. Exactly two front hooves, natural anatomy, no extra limbs. The piglet holds nothing in its hooves.

Style: same painterly, high-detail, soft-glow anime illustration style and lighting quality as image 2 (style reference only; do not copy its composition or the cat).

Composition: portrait 1024x1536. Keep the piglet fully inside the central upper 60% of the image (head to feet visible, centered horizontally), so a centered 3:4 crop keeps the character intact. Background detail may extend to the edges.

Save the result and print the absolute path of the generated PNG file.

candidates.decision: approved — lotus on the top-left, lilac neck scarf, brown eyes, pink body match the original; one raised hoof, empty hooves; shelves of tarot decks, scrolls, crystal ball, honey jars and tea set; no text
